description: Read-only. Session orientation — configured chains and the default, env readiness (RPC/IPFS/subgraph/backend), which toolsets are on or hidden and what the hidden ones unlock, and the DAOs/proposals recorded in this install's local state. Pass `user` to add that wallet's deposited power in the newest recorded DAO. Not needed once the DAO and chain are known. Persisted DAOs/proposals are WINDOWED; the *Total fields carry real counts.

daoLimit.description: Recorded DAOs to return, newest first.

user.description: Wallet address: adds its deposited voting power in the newest recorded DAO (one extra RPC call).
